pose: Static authored pose; animations and procedural Blender shading are represented by the original media.
optimization: Only Web preview scene, prune, deduplicate, Draco compression
procedural_color_fallbacks: 01_TEPAL | living chartreuse throat to translucent ivory
02_FILAMENT | pale green insertion to warm ivory
10_WOOD MULCH | varied dry splinters, fibrous matte
color_policy: Representative colors from original Blender material ramps/mixes; applied to unsupported shaders, preserving existing textures. The Opus chest AO texture is multiplied by its original procedural material color.
